ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast observed with a dominant high-intensity white central field (approx. 80%) bordered by a low-intensity black perimeter and localized dark focal clusters (approx. 20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity band along the trailing edge topography. A dense, vertically-aligned low-intensity cluster originates at the median notch and extends towards the peduncle. Dispersed, low-intensity focal points (circular) mapped across both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe distal region. Mid-intensity brownish-tan pigmentation zones mapped to the lower-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees, bisecting the two fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the continuous trailing edge boundary, characterized by stochastic pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) forming a 'saw-tooth' geometric contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the leading and outer edges of both lobes, terminating in acute-angled, dorsally-oriented tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters distributed across the ventral field, particularly concentrated in the distal half of the right lobe and near the tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical linear discontinuity in pixel intensity extending from the median notch. Secondary faint diagonal linear marks detected on the right lobe mid-section and left lobe lower quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical fissure-like scar originating from the median notch, extending through the primary pigmentation field. Irregular notched trauma and fraying on the distal trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse mid-intensity yellowish-brown pigment patch localized on the left ventral lobe, distinct from the binary black/white contrast zones.
